heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 4: Outpatient Benefits > 4.2 Physiotherapy
content: Out-of-network physiotherapy is covered up to ₹15,000 per year. This limit applies per insured member and resets on the policy anniversary date.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 4: Outpatient Benefits > 4.2 Physiotherapy
content: Coverage for physiotherapy is subject to pre-authorisation by the medical team at least 48 hours before the first session. Claims without pre-authorisation are rejected in full.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 4: Outpatient Benefits > 4.3 Dental
content: Dental treatment is excluded, except for emergency dental procedures required as a result of an accidental injury, which are covered up to ₹10,000 per policy year.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 4: Outpatient Benefits > 4.4 Vision
content: Routine eye examinations are covered once per policy year. Spectacles and contact lenses are not covered under the Silver Plan.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 5: Waiting Periods > 5.1 Maternity
content: Maternity benefits are available after a waiting period of nine months from the policy start date, subject to the member having continuous coverage. Normal delivery is covered up to ₹50,000 and caesarean delivery up to ₹75,000.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 5: Waiting Periods > 5.2 Pre-existing Conditions
content: Pre-existing diseases declared at enrolment are covered after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous coverage. Undeclared pre-existing conditions are not covered.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 6: Hospitalisation > 6.1 Room Rent
content: Room rent is covered up to 1% of the sum insured per day for a standard room and 2% for an intensive care unit. Charges above this limit are borne by the member, along with a proportionate deduction on associated charges.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 7: Exclusions > 7.1 General Exclusions
content: The policy does not cover cosmetic surgery, treatment for obesity, self-inflicted injuries, or injuries sustained while under the influence of alcohol or drugs, unless specifically included by a rider.

heading_path: Silver Plan Policy > Section 3: Definitions > 3.1 Policy Year
content: Policy year means the twelve-month period beginning on the policy start date shown in the schedule. All annual limits reset at the start of each policy year.

heading_path: Gold Plan Policy > Section 4: Outpatient Benefits > 4.2 Physiotherapy
content: Out-of-network physiotherapy is reimbursed at 70% of the billed amount, up to ₹40,000 per policy year. In-network physiotherapy at empanelled clinics is covered at 100% with no annual limit.

heading_path: Gold Plan Policy > Section 4: Outpatient Benefits > 4.3 Dental
content: Dental treatment, including routine check-ups, fillings and extractions, is covered up to ₹25,000 per policy year. Cosmetic dental procedures are excluded.

heading_path: Gold Plan Policy > Section 5: Waiting Periods > 5.1 Maternity
content: Under the Gold Plan, maternity benefits are available after a waiting period of six months. Normal delivery is covered up to ₹1,00,000 and caesarean delivery up to ₹1,50,000, including pre-natal and post-natal expenses.

heading_path: Gold Plan Policy > Section 6: Hospitalisation > 6.1 Room Rent
content: The Gold Plan has no room rent sub-limit. Members may choose any room category, including a single private room, at any network hospital.

heading_path: Riders Catalogue > GP-7 Rider: Global Protect
content: The GP-7 rider extends in-patient hospitalisation cover to treatment received outside India, up to the full sum insured, for emergency admissions during trips of up to 45 days. Planned overseas treatment is not covered under GP-7.

heading_path: Riders Catalogue > GP-2 Rider: Hospital Cash
content: The GP-2 rider pays a fixed daily cash benefit of ₹2,000 for each day of in-patient hospitalisation beyond 48 hours, for a maximum of 30 days per policy year. The benefit is paid in addition to any hospitalisation claim.

heading_path: Riders Catalogue > GP-4 Rider: Critical Illness
content: The GP-4 rider pays a lump sum of ₹5,00,000 on first diagnosis of any of the 20 listed critical illnesses, including cancer, heart attack and stroke, provided the member survives 30 days after diagnosis.

heading_path: Claims Handbook > Section 1: Cashless Claims
content: For cashless treatment, present your health card at the network hospital's insurance desk. The hospital sends a pre-authorisation request to us and we respond within 4 hours for planned admissions and within 1 hour for emergencies.

heading_path: Claims Handbook > Section 2: Reimbursement Claims
content: For treatment at a non-network hospital, pay the bills yourself and submit the claim form, original bills, discharge summary and prescriptions within 30 days of discharge. Reimbursement is processed within 15 working days of receiving complete documents.

heading_path: Claims Handbook > Section 3: Rejected Claims and Appeals
content: If a claim is rejected, the rejection letter states the policy clause relied upon. A member may appeal in writing within 60 days. Appeals are reviewed by a separate grievance committee.

heading_path: Network Hospital Guide > Section 1: Finding a Network Hospital
content: Network hospitals, also called empanelled or in-network providers, are listed on the member portal and in the mobile app. Treatment at a listed hospital qualifies for cashless settlement. Hospitals not on the list are treated as out-of-network.

heading_path: Wellness Programme > Section 1: Annual Health Check
content: Every insured adult member is entitled to one free preventive health check-up per policy year at a network diagnostic centre, including blood tests, ECG and a physician consultation.

heading_path: Circular 2025/03: Silver Plan physiotherapy limit revision
content: This circular, dated 15 March 2025, revises the annual out-of-network physiotherapy limit under the Silver Plan from ₹15,000 to ₹20,000, effective 1 April 2025. With effect from 1 April, the revised annual limit of ₹20,000 shall apply. All claims received after this date will be assessed against the revised limit. Pre-authorisation requirements remain unchanged.
